notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.notes:
Unlock the [b]custom[/b] game mode

[b][u]Set the[/u][/b]
[list][*]size and maximum size of the square
[*]count of different colors[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710719/d786a7fe3b8252c30f3bbb6475a6082a2b9d7b72.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Further you can set the[/u][/b]
[list][*]timer before a new line spawns
[*]incremental decrease of consecutive timers
[*]and where these lines will be added
[*]count of locked blocks
[*]a rotationspeed of the square
[*]minimum number of blocks that are required for a complete line[/list]

and then play this setup for as long as you like

Chose your prefered level. From pretty simple like 5x5 with 3 colors or slightly more challanging 8x8 with 8 colors.
Find your sweetspot and stay there as long as it's fun.

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.notes:
[list][*][h2]New designs[/h2]
The standard colors have been improved and patterns have been added to the standard block
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710719/fe6cd37080bb1b72234a2d22bbacdb5f274420f5.jpg[/img]
[*][h2]Additional language support[/h2]
[list][*]French
[*]Spanish[/list]
[*][h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved color distribution at level start
[*]Bugfix: The display of the current blocks of the level was sometimes not updated
[*]Bugfix: A line couldn't be removed if at the same moment the timer ran out and a new line would be added
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.notes:
[list][*][h2]Added Multilanguage-Support[/h2]
German translation added - more to come
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710719/73c2c3d83d56ebc8f6807c7d01c0f12ac907b30b.jpg[/img]
[*][h2]Changed control behavior[/h2]
Removed movement restriction while line dissolution
Now you can move the "Moving Block" around while Line is disappearing/spawning
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.01
